author: reek
body: Probe: the GPU command buffer has its own typed surface. gpu-mem-write and gpu-mem-read carry the Gpu.Memory effect row, so a function with a pure signature cannot compose a triangle through them. The effectful call cannot hide in a plain let (CDX2033) and the Gpu.Memory effect is not declared in the signature (CDX2031).

author: reek
body: This is the compile-time half of the window guard. The runtime half (cap-gpu-mem-denied) refuses a raw poke-32 into the window without the bit, but a refusal met at runtime is a silent -1 and a black screen. The row is what turns that into a diagnostic at the definition site, which is the same bargain gpu-out struck for the port window.
